violations.why: irq_amber preempts irq_fern and resets v_loom between the increment and the read.
irq_amber can write v_loom between fern's read and its later write.
irq_cobalt preempts irq_fern and clears v_loom between the write and the read.
irq_cobalt can write v_loom between fern's read and its later write.
irq_cobalt preempts irq_amber between its write and the check of v_loom.
irq_cobalt resets v_ridge between fern's use as an index and its increment.
irq_cobalt resets v_beacon in the middle of fern's non-atomic increment, so the update is lost.
